# Certification Authority

## Summary
The certifying body: name, signatory, seal, verification base URL, number prefix and the sequence counter Issue Certificate increments.

## Usage
```ts
import { CertificationAuthority } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/audit/certification-authority';

@field authority = linksTo(() => CertificationAuthority);
```

A certificate card links the authority that issued it.

## Non-goals
Not an organisation directory entry.
